body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Coby showcased its new digital photo frames at CES 2009, which features easy-to-use Vividshare software that puts creativity at the user's fingertips.
Available in a variety of contemporary designs, these innovative units incorporate slideshow playback, and custom soundtrack.
